rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Registration name: VISsnowit
Exhibition name: Midsummersnow ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Martin Vissers (Belgium, 2001).
Introduced in Belgium by Viva International BVBA in 2009 as 'Midsummersnow'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Flowers brilliant white.. Small, red spotted cream-yellow pointed buds on purplish-red young shoots.. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 2". Medium, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in large clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, compact, upright. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 28" (60 to 70cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6a through 9a. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant, very blackspot resistant., very mildew resistant.
